profile: position-specific emission log2 odds with symmetric 0.5 per-amino-acid pseudocount and uniform0.05 background
transition_estimation: gapless experimental GB1 alignments observe MM only; MI/MD and I/D continuation rates supplied by explicit Dirichlet/geometric priors, not inferred wet-experiment indels
database: synthetic iid amino-acid background, 500 planted experimental-domain-derived sequences with 0..11 random point mutations; not 100000 experimentally annotated proteins
semantics: glocal full 56-position domain, free restart over sequence; starts at match1, ends at match56 or delete56; insert emissions have background odds1; no HMMER Evalue calibration or MSV filter
